During the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Thaereian military]], an [[Army/Legends|armed force]] [[Thaereian Navy charter|chartered]] to defend the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], operated a '''base''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ostfrei]]. The [[Thaereian]]s maintained secrecy regarding the enclave's existence.  
 
==History==
During the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="LFCG" /> the [[Thaereian military]],<ref name="Retcon">The Living Force Campaign described the Ostfrei base as a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] installation, however the [[Wizards.com]] ''Living Force'' tie-in article ''[[Over Thaere]]'' [[Retroactive continuity|retrospectively established]] all mentions of the Republic Military in the ''Living Force Campaign Guide'' as being references to the [[Thaereian military]].</ref> the [[Army/Legends|armed forces]] of the [[Thaereian system]], were [[Thaereian Navy charter|chartered]] by the Galactic Republic to defend the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="Over Thaere">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011004b_thaere&c=swlfc|text=Over Thaere|int=Over Thaere}}</ref> The [[Thaereian]]s founded a military base on [[Ostfrei]], an uncolonized [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the Cularin system [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] and kept the installation's existence secret from the Cularin system's inhabitants. Though<ref name="LFCG" /> Thaereian military<ref name="Retcon" /> [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] were occasionally sighted by residents of Genarius in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Ostfrei, no-one further investigated Thaereian activities on the moon.<ref name="LFCG" />
 
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group had established a [[Ostfrei pirate base|base of operations]] on Ostfrei, on the opposite side of the moon to the Thaereian installation. The pirates learned of the existence of the Thaereian military facility and considered that the Thaereians would never suspect the presence of a pirate operation so close to the Thaereian enclave. The pirates closely monitored movements at the Thaereian facility to ensure that the pirate base remained hidden and maintained [[Computer/Legends|computer]] records detailing the Thaereian military base's location.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
 
{{RPG|''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]''}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the [[Tarasin]] [[Sa'arli]], an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to the Cularin system's [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], hired a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of freelance agents]] to investigate reports of activity on the surface of Ostfrei. The freelancers raided the pirate base on the moon and obtained intelligence regarding the existence of the Thaereian enclave on Ostfrei, which they subsequently shared with Sa'arli.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
{{Endgame}}
 
==Behind the scenes==
The Thaereian military base on Ostfrei was first mentioned in the ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'', a ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook written by [[Robert Wiese]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] to detail the Cularin system and set the scene for the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] campaign. The sourcebook described the installation as being a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] base,<ref name="LFCG" /> however the [[2002]] [[Wizards.com]] ''Living Force'' tie-in article ''[[Over Thaere]]'' by [[Morrie Mullins]] [[Retroactive continuity|retrospectively established]] all mentions of the Republic Military in the ''Living Force Campaign Guide'' as being references to the Thaereian military.<ref name="Over Thaere" /> The base was later referenced in the [[2003]] ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'' by [[Ronald A. Heintz]].<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
 
In ''Who Goes Thaere?'' the players roleplay as the freelance agents sent by Sa'arli to Ostfrei. It is possible for the player characters to learn of the existence of the military base either from the computer systems of the Ostfrei pirate group or by bartering with one of the pirates. The players can then choose to disclose to Sa'arli the existence of the Thaereian enclave.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
